daily_crawler_accrual_metrics.claim_limit: non_self_originated_requests_count counts requests this project did not make; it is NOT a crawler count. known_crawler_ua_matches is the only figure this project will describe as crawler access.

phase_2_latency_benchmarks.target: Deployed Cloud Run / Vertex AI Agent Path

h6_revocation_cascade_real_corpus_scale.note: Re-measured 2026-08-14 on revision 00045-dkz, the first deployment carrying both parallel sessions' work. Warm rose from ~519 ms to ~737 ms: the cascade now takes an execution lease and writes an idempotency outbox record alongside the revocation event, so a retry cannot double-issue a notice and an abandoned worker cannot commit late. The added ~220 ms is the cost of exactly-once business effects; it is reported rather than absorbed because the recording script quotes this figure.

natural_language_license_path.note: Re-measured 2026-08-14 on revision 00045-dkz while verifying that the recording script's beats still run. Each request includes one server-side Vertex AI generateContent call (scope interpretation). Rose from 3175 ms measured 2026-08-07.

overclaim_lint_coverage.layers: deterministic regex list, then an embedding backstop (src/evidence/semantic_backstop.py, gemini-embedding-001) that can only ADD refusals; with the backstop unreachable, coverage falls back to rejected_by_regex_alone
overclaim_lint_coverage.claim_limit: The lint is a backstop against the exact phrasings it enumerates, not a general paraphrase detector. The STRUCTURAL guarantee is the schema: EvidenceRecord.class has no training-membership value, so the system cannot emit the claim as data. The lint only reduces the chance of it appearing in free text.

failure_tolerance_drill.note: Worker forced into an infinite loop. Server-side time is dominated by the 1.0s supervisor deadline, as designed: detection cannot be faster than the deadline it is waiting on. Quarantine, deregistration and reroute add ~110ms on top. The first run includes a Cloud Run cold start.

defect_ledger.counting_rule: one entry per distinct defect with a distinct fix; a recurrence in a new location is a new entry

buyer_api_license_path.note: The permitted path rose from ~399 ms (2026-08-10) because its receipt is now signed by Cloud KMS — one asymmetricSign round-trip per issued receipt. The DENIED path is faster than the permitted one for exactly that reason: a denial issues no receipt, so it signs nothing. Supersedes h6_buyer_api_with_model_armor, which was measured before KMS signing existed and whose name refers to a product this project could not use.
